quotes.text: Even if the operation failed, there may be some messages to deal with.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The extracted EWS handler reports accumulated new-message keys on both success and failure. Its folder stop callback processes those keys for new-mail state, filtering and autosync even when final status is a failure, then forwards the actual operation status to the URL listener. FolderLoaded is emitted on this stop path; it does not alone establish successful synchronization. Fixed accepted Exchange code retains this split while adding header arrays and later filtering/count behavior. No partial-failure execution was run.
title: Message sync reports partial additions separately from its final failure status
